<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:20">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᵈ</cite> <he>וכתב ליה מן סֵיבְתֵיה בגוה</he> (not <he>ויהב</he>) and he informed him therein of his (expected) appointment as elder.—Pl. <cite ref="O00548"><he>סֵיבָתָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00536"><he>סֵבָ׳</he></cite>.
